description: The shared world every API interaction is written against. The provider side builds it for real (backend/tests/contracts/states.py); the consumer side (frontend/test/contracts/) uses the same values as inputs. Ids are illustrative: before replaying a request, the provider swaps each placeholder for the real value it created under that role.

geocoder.description: What the provider's stubbed geocoder answers for any address. Nominatim itself is not under contract here.

provider_states.registered_user: The user exists and can sign in.
provider_states.user_with_person: registered_user, plus Grace Hopper in Milwaukee with preferred airport 2364 (MDW) and station 1753.
provider_states.user_with_contacted_person: user_with_person, plus one CALL logged with her on 2026-10-20.
provider_states.user_with_trip: user_with_person, plus a DRAFT trip with two stops (Grace, then MDW) and the leg between them.
